messages.subject: Project Tempest - engagement and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Edward, Fiona,

Thank you for the call yesterday. As discussed, we are very happy to act for the group on the restructuring of the WCB senior facilities (which we are referring to internally as Project Tempest).

I attach under separate cover our engagement letter, which sets out scope, team and our fee estimate of £220k-£260k plus VAT through to completion of the amendment and restatement. James Osei (cc'd) will be your day-to-day contact alongside me.

Immediate priorities are (i) agreeing a short standstill with Sterling so we take enforcement risk off the table, and (ii) getting Marlow's independent business review under way. Could you let me have the latest management accounts and the current 13-week cashflow today if possible?

Kind regards,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield | Partner, Restructuring & Finance

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

Sarah,

Thank you - that all makes sense and we're grateful you can move quickly. Edward and I have signed the engagement letter and I'll return it this afternoon.

Management accounts to October and the latest cashflow are attached for James. Neil Ashby at WCB will be your contact on the operational numbers. Please treat the leverage position as highly sensitive internally.

Best,
